editorial.blurb: A beloved Logan spot where handmade empanadas in a dozen flavor varieties steal the show, paired with excellent café con leche and breakfast tortas at prices that beat the chains.
editorial.insiderTip: Go early for breakfast and don't skip the birria empanada—it's the standout that keeps regulars coming back. Most folks order to-go, but there are a couple small tables if you want to linger.
